_meta.description: Limits and correction text for .claude/hooks/ask-question-shape-hook.js (#3233). maxOptions and maxHeaderLength are the tool's own hard limits (#3198), which it rejects as "Invalid tool parameters" without saying which, so the hook acts first. Since #3638 a header over maxHeaderLength is trimmed to it and the call goes through; more than maxOptions options blocks with the fix named. remedy.header is still used when a call blocks with a header problem in it: one that also has too many options, or a header with nothing to trim to. Since #3463 the hook no longer blocks question length or block content: that is convention, documented in Reference/AskUserQuestion-Shape.md, and the tool accepts it.

remedy.options: Offer at most {maxOptions} options: merge or drop the rest, or split the decision into two questions.

pointer: Templates, the context table and previews: `{frameworkPath}/Reference/AskUserQuestion-Shape.md`.
